name: OT/ICS Firmware Triage
description: Queries MISP for all Firmware research events. For each event, iterates vulnerability objects to extract ICS scoring fields stored during import. Scores each vulnerability (CVSS + exploit complexity + operational impact + exposure + KEV + EPSS), writes a triage summary back to the MISP event as a comment attribute, and returns ranked vulnerabilities with disclosure drafts. Run after reviewing events imported by OT/ICS Firmware Findings Import.
